abstract: Install, serve, tune and scale SGLang v0.5.x on NVIDIA, AMD, DGX Spark and other hardware: pip/uv and lmsysorg/sglang images, launch flags, parallelism and multi-node, parsers, structured output, speculative decoding, LoRA, multimodal, embeddings, benchmarking, metrics and updates. Detail lives in references, with DGX Spark and PD-disaggregation combos and deployment templates.
